business_summary.text: WeWork India operates a branded flexible workspace network across eight Indian cities, offering core workspace, value-added services and digital products.

call_memory.statement: Digital products operate at close to 80% EBITDA margin and VAS is margin accretive.

lab.quote: In H1, that FCFO funded our entire INR363.8 crores of capex, the largest we have ever deployed, and left a surplus of INR16 crores.

call_memory.quote: In H1, that FCFO funded our entire INR363.8 crores of capex, the largest we have ever deployed, and left a surplus of INR16 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: H1 capex deployed was INR 363.8 crores, completely funded by FCFO of INR 379.8 crores with INR 16 crores surplus.

lab.quote: minimum wage increases that hit us basically in this first half for Karnataka was nearly 60%, Haryana was also sizable, and we also got hit with a lot of energy, backdated energy tariffs, especially from BESCOM in Karnataka, which is our largest portfolio.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Minimum wage increases in Karnataka rose nearly 60% alongside backdated energy tariffs from BESCOM, increasing opex cost per square foot.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT

lab.quote: And in terms of renewals and all of that, you'll see that our renewal percentage is close, around 80% to 85% even for the first half of this year.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Customer renewal rate was around 80% to 85% for the first half of the year.

lab.quote: I think you should look at a range of between 1.2 to 1.5x in terms of what this number would look like.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Free cash flow from operations to EBITDA ratio is expected to remain in the range of 1.2x to 1.5x driven by security deposits and customization advances.

lab.quote: across most of our assets, we are only putting in heavy investment back between year five and year seven, depending on the product and the wear and tear of those assets.

call_memory.quote: across most of our assets, we are only putting in heavy investment back between year five and year seven, depending on the product and the wear and tear of those assets.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Heavy refurbishment capex is deployed only between year five and year seven across most assets depending on wear and tear.

lab.quote: So, I think in the quarter, we would have done about INR18 crores of customization revenue, and close to maybe about INR30 crores in the first half of this year in terms of customization revenue, which has a flow-through down to EBITDA.

call_memory.quote: So, I think in the quarter, we would have done about INR18 crores of customization revenue, and close to maybe about INR30 crores in the first half of this year in terms of customization revenue, which has a flow-through down to EBITDA.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Customization revenue was about INR 18 crores in Q2 and close to INR 30 crores in H1, with lumpiness now normalized and large deals amortized.

lab.quote: And so, I think easily there's another visibility like of over 2 million square feet over and above this 13 that we have across various different assets that we're looking at right now itself, it's just not signed.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Company has visibility on over 2 million square feet in discussion and evaluation beyond the 13 million square feet already signed under LOIs.

lab.quote: And like we mentioned in Q1, we've embarked on this corporate action of getting rid of our book losses or creating the ability for us to pay dividends or do buybacks.

call_memory.quote: And like we mentioned in Q1, we've embarked on this corporate action of getting rid of our book losses or creating the ability for us to pay dividends or do buybacks.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Company initiated corporate actions to eliminate book losses to enable paying dividends or conducting buybacks.

lab.quote: We're actually, we've signed one of probably our largest deal ever, which we will announce in the next quarter.

call_memory.quote: We're actually, we've signed one of probably our largest deal ever, which we will announce in the next quarter.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Company signed its largest deal ever and plans to announce it in the next quarter, requiring significant capex deployment to that single asset.

lab.quote: In terms of FY28, like I mentioned, we're looking at extending the expansion or like adding more seats than we did this year. So, capex would possibly be closer to the INR600 crores mark, or maybe even slightly more than that for FY28.

call_memory.quote: In terms of FY28, like I mentioned, we're looking at extending the expansion or like adding more seats than we did this year. So, capex would possibly be closer to the INR600 crores mark, or maybe even slightly more than that for FY28.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Capex for FY28 would possibly be closer to the INR600 crores mark, or maybe even slightly more than that.

call_points.text: GCCs account for nearly 41% of the overall mix, driving strong demand for flexible workspaces.
FY27 capex guidance held at ₹500-600 Cr; management sees visibility today.
Customization revenue guided at ₹10-15 Cr a quarter as large managed-office customization is amortised.
VAS revenue seen at 11-12% of total and digital at 3-4%, together about 16%.
Management expects to continue growing top-line revenue at over 20% year-over-year.
Capex for FY27 is estimated to be in the range of ₹500 crores to ₹600 crores.
